definitions.explanation: The pressure of blood against the walls of the arteries.

examples.japanese: {血圧|けつあつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}って→測る：01977_hakaru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had my blood pressure measured.

examples.japanese: {血圧|けつあつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んでいる→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I'm taking medication because my blood pressure is high.

examples.japanese: ⟦{塩分|えんぶん}→塩分：09945_enbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦すぎ→すぎ：09885_sugi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{血圧|けつあつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
examples.english: Consuming too much salt raises blood pressure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{血圧|けつあつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}っています→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: I measure my blood pressure every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{血圧|けつあつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われて→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦{塩分|えんぶん}→塩分：09945_enbun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつけています→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧。
examples.english: The doctor told me my blood pressure is high, so I am watching my salt intake.

notes:
{血圧|けつあつ} is the standard word at checkups, in pharmacies, and in everyday talk about health; it is not confined to medical writing.

READINGS ON A CHART:
- ⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{血圧|けつあつ}, formally ⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧{血圧|けつあつ} (systolic, the upper number)
- ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{血圧|けつあつ}, formally ⟦{最低|さいてい}→最低：01412_saitei⟧{血圧|けつあつ} (diastolic, the lower number)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {血圧|けつあつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧ (to take a blood pressure reading)
- {血圧|けつあつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ / ⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ (blood pressure is high / low)
- {血圧|けつあつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧ / ⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to lower / raise blood pressure)
- {血圧|けつあつ}⟦{計|けい}→計：02691_kei⟧ (blood pressure monitor)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{高|こう}{血圧|けつあつ}→高血圧：04415_kouketsuatsu⟧ (hypertension, as a diagnosed condition)
- ⟦{低|てい}{血圧|けつあつ}→低血圧：07103_teiketsuatsu⟧ (hypotension)
